records.text: maisat baxala siw ka, maikixiay nimisiw a ina

senses.zh: 如果你罵 Baxala ，我就要告訴他媽媽
senses.en: If you scold Baxala, I'll tell his mother.

senses.en: Then (she) paid no attention to Awi.

records.text: isia rezaw meken alaw ki abuk
isia rezaw mupuzah mikita yaku misiw

senses.en: He often comes to see me.

records.text: imisiw a saw ka isia rezaw daadaux tamaku

senses.en: That man is always smoking a cigarette.
